sources.title: VelociQ8/multilingual-e5-base-Q8A64-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository holds multilingual-e5-base converted to Q8A64, the 8-bit weight format of VelociQ8, to run on the CPU. It turns text in about 100 languages into vectors for retrieval, similarity, classification and clustering, with a short prefix on queries and on passages. Base model intfloat ...

sources.snippet: What is multilingual-e5-base? multilingual-e5-base is an open-weight embedding model that turns text into vectors for search and retrieval, published by Microsoft (intfloat) with open weights at intfloat/multilingual-e5-base.

sources.title: Releases: dhaern/VelociQ8 - GitHub
sources.snippet: Mixture-of-experts models now run their expert weights in Q8A64. On granite-3.1-1b-a400m and OLMoE-1B-7B, prompt processing is 1.8 to 2.1 times faster than llama.cpp v0.7.0 with Q8_0 on the Arm test machine and 1.5 times faster on the Ryzen 9 5950X, with less divergence from the original weights.
